<!-- thinkweave:start -->
If `weave_*` MCP tools are available, thinkweave (Obsidian-native memory layer) is your durable memory for this session. Prefer `weave_search` / `weave_context` / `weave_graph` over filesystem search. This harness only fires a session-end hook once its hooks are installed and trusted, so call `weave_extract` yourself before you finish — it is what persists the session's insights and decisions into the vault.
<!-- thinkweave:end -->
